q1.explanationZh: instinct 名词“本能；直觉”，by instinct“凭本能”。

q2.explanationZh: institute 名词“学会；研究所；学院”，注意中间是 -sti-，结尾 -tute。

q3.explanationZh: institution 名词“机构”，由 institute 去 e 加 -ion 构成。

q4.explanationZh: instruct 及物动词“教；指示”，instruct sb. to do sth.“命令/教某人做某事”。

q5.explanationZh: instruction 是 instruct 的名词形式，复数 instructions 表示“用法说明”。

q6.explanationZh: instrument 名词“仪器；乐器”，a musical instrument“一件乐器”。

q7.explanationZh: insult 动词、名词同形：作动词重音在后 /ɪnˈsʌlt/，作名词重音在前 /ˈɪnsʌlt/。

q8.explanationZh: insurance 是 insure 的名词形式“保险”，insurance company“保险公司”。

q9.explanationZh: insure 及物动词“给……保险”，insure sth. against fire“给……保火险”。

q10.explanationZh: integrate“使结合，使成一体”，integrate A into/with B“把 A 融入 B”。

q11.explanationZh: integrity 名词“正直；完整”，a man of integrity“正直的人”。

q12.explanationZh: intellect 名词“智力；理解力”，注意双写 l。

q13.explanationZh: intellectual 作形容词“智力的”，作名词“知识分子”，由 intellect 加 -ual 构成。

q14.explanationZh: intelligence 名词“才智；情报”，以 -ence 结尾，与形容词 intelligent 对应。

q15.explanationZh: intelligent 形容词“聪明的”，以 -ent 结尾，注意双写 l。

q16.explanationZh: intend 及物动词“打算”，intend to do sth.“打算做某事”。

q17.explanationZh: intense 形容词“强烈的；紧张的”，副词是 intensely。

q18.explanationZh: intention 是 intend 的名词形式“意图”，have no intention of doing“无意做……”。

q19.explanationZh: interaction 由 inter-（相互）+ action 构成，“相互作用；互动”。

q20.explanationZh: interest 作动词“使感兴趣”，作名词“兴趣；爱好”，表示“各种爱好”时可数。

q21.explanationZh: interesting 形容词“有趣的”，形容事物本身；interested 指人“感兴趣的”。

q22.explanationZh: intermediate 形容词“中间的；中级的”，由 inter-（在中间）+ mediate 构成。

q23.explanationZh: internal 形容词“内部的”，反义词是 external“外部的”。

q24.explanationZh: international 由 inter-（之间）+ national 构成，“国际的”。

q25.explanationZh: internet“互联网”，前面常加 the：on the internet“在网上”。

q26.explanationZh: interpret 动词“解释；口译”，interpret for sb.“给某人当翻译”。

q27.explanationZh: interpret 加 -er 构成 interpreter“译员；口译者”。

q28.explanationZh: interrupt 及物动词“打断”，注意双写 r：inter-rupt。

q29.explanationZh: interval 名词“间隔”，at intervals“不时地；每隔一段时间”。

q30.explanationZh: intervention 名词“干涉；干预”，foreign intervention“外国干涉”。

q31.explanationZh: interview 名词、动词同形，“采访；面试”，由 inter- + view 构成。

q32.explanationZh: into 介词“到……里面”，表示由外向内的动作，如 come into the house。

q33.explanationZh: introduce 及物动词“介绍；引进”，introduce sb. to sb.“把某人介绍给某人”。

q34.explanationZh: introduction 是 introduce 的名词形式“介绍；序言”，去 e 加 -tion。

q35.explanationZh: intruder 由动词 intrude“闯入”加 -r 构成，“侵入者；闯入者”。

q36.explanationZh: invade 及物动词“侵略；侵犯”，invade the rights of others“侵犯他人权利”。

q37.explanationZh: invent“发明”指造出原来没有的东西；discover 是“发现”已存在的东西。

q38.explanationZh: invention 是 invent 的名词形式“发明”，加 -ion。

q39.explanationZh: inventor 由 invent 加 -or 构成，“发明者”，注意结尾是 -or 不是 -er。

q40.explanationZh: instruct sb. to do sth.“命令/教某人做某事”，后接不定式。

q41.explanationZh: intend ... for ...“打算把……给……用/送给……”，介词用 for。

q42.explanationZh: intend that ...“打算……”，后接宾语从句。

q43.explanationZh: intend to do sth.“打算做某事”，后接不定式。

q44.explanationZh: 答案给 play a joke on sb.；按手册辨析，play a joke on sb. 是“同某人开玩笑（捉弄某人）”，have a joke about sb. 是“开某人的玩笑”。

q45.explanationZh: 答案给 have a joke about sb.；手册中 have a joke about sb. 译为“开某人的玩笑”，play a joke on sb. 译为“同某人开玩笑”。

q46.explanationZh: be interested in (doing sth.)“对（做）……感兴趣”，in 后接名词或动名词。

q47.explanationZh: be interested to do sth.“有兴趣去做某事”，通常指尚未发生的事。

q48.explanationZh: give an interview to sb.“接见某人；接受某人采访”。

q49.explanationZh: have an interview with sb.“会见某人；采访某人”，介词用 with。

q50.explanationZh: introduce sb. to sb. (else)“把某人介绍给另一人”，介词用 to。

q51.explanationZh: introduce oneself“做自我介绍”，oneself 随主语变化，如 introduce myself。

q52.explanationZh: introduce sth. to/into ...“把某物引进到……；向……介绍某物”。

q53.explanationZh: introduce sb. to sth.“使某人初次接触某事”。

q54.explanationZh: insurance“保险”作定语，insurance company“保险公司”。

q55.explanationZh: instruct sb. in sth.“教某人某事”；叙述过去的事，用过去式 instructed。

q56.explanationZh: “用一件像鲁特琴的乐器为她伴奏”，a 后接名词单数 instrument“乐器”。

q57.explanationZh: “他骂她是笨蛋来侮辱她”，insult 作动词，过去的事用过去式 insulted。

q58.explanationZh: was being + 过去分词是过去进行时的被动语态，“正在被采访”，用 interviewed。

q59.explanationZh: a long 后接名词单数，interval“间隔”：隔了好久他才接电话。

q60.explanationZh: “浦东国际机场”是专有名称，International 首字母大写。

q61.explanationZh: “敲门声打断了我们的谈话”，过去的事用过去式 interrupted，注意双写 r。

q62.explanationZh: have an interview with sb.“会见/采访某人”，an 后接名词单数 interview。

q63.explanationZh: introduce sth. to sb.“向某人介绍某事”，过去的事用过去式 introduced。

q64.explanationZh: 空格修饰名词 whistle-blowing，用形容词 internal“内部的”：内部检举。

q65.sampleAnswer: Whenever he thought of going to a foreign country to work for survival by himself, he felt it was a little hard for him to endure it.
references: Whenever he thought of going to a foreign country to work for survival by himself, he felt it was a little hard for him to endure it.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “每当……”= whenever；“单枪匹马”= by himself；“他觉得……吃不消”可用 he felt it was hard for him to endure it，it 指代那件事。

q66.sampleAnswer: What is amazing about the museum is that it integrates the changes in the countryside, the traces of time, and the memories of childhood into a fixed space.
references: What is amazing about the museum is that it integrates the changes in the countryside, the traces of time, and the memories of childhood into a fixed space.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: “……的神奇之处在于”= What is amazing about ... is that ...；“把……融合到……中”= integrate ... into ...。

q67.sampleAnswer: The machine is named after its inventor.
references: The machine is named after its inventor.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: “以……的名字命名”= be named after；“发明者”= inventor。

q68.sampleAnswer: He has no intention of changing his job.
references: He has no intention of changing his job.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q68.explanationZh: “没有做某事的意图”= have no intention of doing sth.，of 后用动名词。

q69.sampleAnswer: She was one of the most caring and intelligent people I’ve ever met.
references: She was one of the most caring and intelligent people I’ve ever met.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q69.explanationZh: “最……的人之一”= one of the most + 形容词 + 复数名词；“我见过的”用定语从句 I’ve ever met。

q70.sampleAnswer: Thanks to his solid professional expertise, several research and development institutions extended offers to this graduate following the interview.
references: Thanks to his solid professional expertise, several research and development institutions extended offers to this graduate following the interview.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q70.explanationZh: “凭借”= thanks to；“多家研发机构”= several research and development institutions，用复数；“伸出橄榄枝”= extend offers to。

q71.sampleAnswer: The policy which was newly released is intended to control the ever-rising housing price and achieve education equality.
references: The policy which was newly released is intended to control the ever-rising housing price and achieve education equality.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q71.explanationZh: “旨在做某事”= be intended to do sth.；“一路攀升的”= ever-rising。

q72.sampleAnswer: If I had learned French, I would be able to interpret for our French friend.
references: If I had learned French, I would be able to interpret for our French friend.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q72.explanationZh: 与过去事实相反的条件（if 从句用 had done），主句说现在的情况用 would do；“给某人当翻译”= interpret for sb.。

q73.sampleAnswer: The significance of the activity lies in the fact that it has contributed to a better interaction between teachers and students.
references: The significance of the activity lies in the fact that it has contributed to a better interaction between teachers and students.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q73.explanationZh: “……的意义在于”= The significance of ... lies in the fact that ...；“促进”= contribute to；“师生间的互动”= interaction between teachers and students。

q74.sampleAnswer: In our school, teachers and students have free access to the internet.
references: In our school, teachers and students have free access to the internet.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q74.explanationZh: “可以免费使用”= have free access to；“上网”即 access the internet，internet 前加 the。
